workerScheduling20261104.environment: Same 26 MP RAF, real Tauri dev WKWebView, worker, 1552x1036 canvas at DPR 2; scratch copies, visible focused window. Sequential performance runs; OS cache not cold.
workerScheduling20261104.scope: Neutral recipe, capture sharpening enabled, Texture/Clarity/Dehaze off. First 50% stop includes upload and global capture threshold; later stops reuse those. Exact decoded payload prepared for six seconds before zoom. Not cold RAW decode latency or p95; effect-heavy recipes not timed.
workerScheduling20261104.baselineMethod: Restored one pass and setTimeout(0) between passes in the instrumented loop for the before run, then restored the final file in a finally block. The old scheduling also failed four of the five loop regression tests.
workerScheduling20261104.preparationMetrics: steps counts generator advances (including completion), cpuMs sums advancing time including synchronous GPU waits, elapsedMs is preparation start to completion, resumeMs is elapsed between advances (GPU waits plus scheduling), maxStepMs is the longest advance. These do not isolate hardware GPU execution.
workerScheduling20261104.discarded: Initial stop harness used completed-frame scale as feedback and overshot its first 50% target; valid=false. That development run also overlapped a Chrome GPU correctness check. Final timing runs were sequential and use latest submitted scale, sequence checks, focus/visibility validation and inexact-frame exclusion.
